purpose: Web-app identity and Key Vault-reference skeleton. Replace bracketed placeholders only during an authorized deployment; this is not a complete ARM deployment template.
name: <APP_NAME>

identityValueUse.resourceId: Use here, in userAssignedIdentities, and for keyVaultReferenceIdentity.
identityValueUse.clientId: Use for DataProtection__ManagedIdentityClientId and sitecontainer userManagedIdentityClientId.
identityValueUse.principalId: Use as the RBAC assignee object ID for AcrPull, Key Vault Crypto User, Key Vault Secrets User, and Storage Blob Data Contributor.
